summary: Skye Bioscience filed an 8-K disclosing the September 8, 2026 resignation of CFO John P. Sharp, who also served as principal financial and accounting officer. The company simultaneously terminated its March 31, 2026 Master Services Agreement with Lohman Associates, effective the same date. On September 9, 2026, the board appointed President and CEO Punit Dhillon as principal financial and accounting officer, with his employment terms unchanged. No disagreement with auditors or the company was cited. Watch for a permanent CFO search, interim control gaps, and any restatement or accounting-risk flags in subsequent filings.
